generated_behavior_inputs.reasoning: StoredAttempt positional record is the durable JSON journal value:AttemptRequestId,Succeeded,Error?,AtUtc. Constructor/with-copy do not validate nonblank id/timestamp or establish hardware success. System.Text.Json roundtrips public generated properties;Find returns immutable scalar/string record so no exposed mutable collection. Processor writes false uncertain state before transport,then actual transport result;restart reuses same AttemptRequestId for report rather than printing again. Generated ToString contains Error diagnostic and timestamp,so should not be treated sanitized telemetry automatically.
generated_behavior_inputs.inputs: AttemptRequestId string,Succeeded bool,Error nullable string,AtUtc DateTimeOffset.
generated_behavior_inputs.outputs: Journal serialization/deserialization record,not paper completion proof.
generated_behavior_inputs.side_effects: Record allocation itself noneexternal;Remember/Save persist entire dictionary separately.
generated_behavior_inputs.trust_boundaries: File deserialization trusts journal contents after JSONshape;malformed JSON fails closed but semantically malformed record fields not constructor-validated.
generated_behavior_inputs.database: No SQL in record;report result later writes server attempt.
generated_behavior_inputs.printing_ui: Succeeded means transport-returned status,PRT002,not physical output;uncertain false entries deliberately stop replay print.
generated_behavior_inputs.performance: Small record,whole journal serialization cost belongs Save;no generated observable notifications.
generated_behavior_inputs.duplicates_conflicts: Value equality exact strings/scalars;with changes can alter report identity,actual processor preserves it. Journal key is PrintJobId separate from record.
issues_hypotheses: Manual journal tampering/semantic corruption not detected by record constructor;local trust issue
tests_missing: Missing/null AttemptRequestId,uncertain false/error roundtrip,same record across restart and no duplicate physical output;no hardware executed

scope: Generated contexts are behavior accounting, not individually counted source/CLR methods.
